notablePrerequisites:
Obeka has power 4 or greater and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You are the monarch.
description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Illustrious Wanderglyph triggers, creating a 1/1 Gnome artifact creature token.
Deal combat damage using Obeka.
Obeka triggers, causing you to get at least four upkeep steps after this phase.
Repeat step 1 during each of the additional upkeep steps.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five Gnomes, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
